lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with a slight compression of distance between lines in the posterior third of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior five lines demonstrate significant discontinuities, transitioning from solid segments to discrete circular spots halfway down the flank.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 10-12 high-contrast white spots is concentrated on the lateral posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric row below the vertical line terminations.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes; two white spots on the lower cheek; a white patch on the lower neck/throat; and white banding on the proximal and distal segments of all visible limbs.
